note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Object A is a generic fictional object; no person is drawn and no state is shown as a harm caused by someone. The two states (prior condition / later change) and the levels are supplied placeholders on an illustrative scale, never real figures; nothing is measured, valued, attributed or decided, and no cause, fault, liability or outcome is stated. Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events, causalLinks, alternatives, losses (the variation as supplied), actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are all editable; 'object' and 'levels' are added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; scene-area floor >= 0.20 of the frame in every preset, accepted LAW-0701). True driver: the 1:1 box — the physical scene (panel, flags, floor) must cover >= 0.20 of the frame area while the stress text stays >= 16 px. Fallbacks tried: every existing composition (side, split, tall = right-hand column, below, below2) and a new compact-list composition (panel left, right-hand column with the variation chip, the record and the legend as a compact list continuing under the panel). Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy in production/scratch/causation-07/LAW-0705.stress-precap.json): full counts (five entries, two accounts, one link, two variation items, two notes) → old 'tall' 17 px, scene area 0.101; compact list 17 px 0.153, at 16 px 0.184; one account and one note only → 0.176; four entries only → 0.169; four entries, one note and the longer account (the second) → 0.184. The stress therefore caps the COUNTS at four entries (the first four), one account put forward (the first) and one note (the first) (baseline 3 / 0 / 1; the link and both variation items kept); every text field keeps its near-maximum length. After the cap: 1:1 compact list 17 px, scene area 0.211 (labels hidden 0.258); 16:9 19 px, 0.393; 9:16 20 px, 0.226.
